t: String NYC - Woolly&Co.
s: Rated by Zagat’s shopping guide as the #1 knitting store and #1 lifestyle store in New York City, String is committed to projects that marry traditional knitting techniques with modern sensibility. Located on the Upper East Side of Manhattan, String’s discerning collection of yarns sourced from the finest mills around the world, features luxury fibers, including cashmere, cashmere blends, merino wool, silk and hand-dyed yarns.
